This leaves options B and D, both of which have five blocks. Examine the arrangement of these blocks. The correct arrangement should have three blocks in a straight line at the front and two blocks going up directly in the middle.

Option B matches this arrangement with three blocks in a line and two blocks in the middle. Option D does not match because it does not have the first three blocks in a line and has an extra block on the left.
Therefore, the correct top-down 2D view of the 3D structure is option B.
